name: Every check in the project, and the health of every subject that has one
description: Every check in the project, and the health of every subject that has one Every check in the project, and the health of every subject that has one. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/data_quality_checks/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/data_quality_checks/
Every check in the project, and the health of every subject that has one. The per-subject surfaces answer "what is wrong with this table". This answers "what is wrong across the project", which they cannot: each is nested under one parent. Read-only -- authoring still happens against the subject that owns the check.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.
